interactions.description: Combination may cause additive hypotensive effects and bradycardia
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely

interactions.description: Increased risk of bleeding due to additive antiplatelet effects
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination if possible, monitor INR and signs of bleeding

interactions.description: Increased risk of lactic acidosis, especially with chronic alcohol use
interactions.recommendation: Limit alcohol consumption and monitor renal function

interactions.description: Increased risk of hyperkalemia
interactions.recommendation: Monitor serum potassium levels, avoid potassium supplements

interactions.description: Increased risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination, use alternative antibiotic

interactions.description: Increased digoxin levels leading to toxicity
interactions.recommendation: Reduce digoxin dose by 50% and monitor levels

interactions.description: Mutual metabolism interference leading to unpredictable levels
interactions.recommendation: Monitor drug levels and adjust doses accordingly

interactions.description: Increased risk of serotonin syndrome
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination, use alternative analgesic

interactions.description: Reduced effectiveness of clopidogrel
interactions.recommendation: Use alternative PPI like pantoprazole

interactions.description: Increased statin levels due to CYP3A4 inhibition
interactions.recommendation: Avoid grapefruit consumption or use lower statin dose

interactions.description: Hypertensive crisis
interactions.recommendation: Strict dietary restriction of tyramine-containing foods

interactions.description: Increased theophylline levels leading to toxicity
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination or reduce theophylline dose

interactions.description: Reduced contraceptive effectiveness
interactions.recommendation: Use additional contraception during antibiotic course

interactions.description: Increased risk of renal impairment
interactions.recommendation: Monitor renal function and hydration status

interactions.description: Masked hypoglycemia symptoms
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood glucose more frequently

interactions.description: Increased CNS depression
interactions.recommendation: Avoid alcohol or use with caution

interactions.description: Reduced levothyroxine absorption
interactions.recommendation: Take levothyroxine 4 hours apart from calcium

interactions.description: Severe CNS depression and respiratory depression
interactions.recommendation: Strictly avoid alcohol while taking benzodiazepines

interactions.description: Reduced antibiotic absorption
interactions.recommendation: Take quinolones 2 hours before or after antacids

interactions.description: Increased risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination or use alternative antifungal
